confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from several aggregated or crowdsourced Jaipur cost-of-living and travel-budget sources, some undated, so precision is moderate. Cocktail and wine are weaker: no Jaipur-specific cocktail or wine average was found, so cocktail is set from a beer-relative ratio and cross-checked against hotel and Mumbai bar menus, and wine uses one Jaipur hotel menu plus the same beer-relative ratio. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings, and July is monsoon low season. The fx observation is the latest official RBA page I could verify (20 March 2026), so it is stale relative to the 19 November 2026 reference date; a later figure reported by a third party could not be confirmed on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city used. Food and coffee anchors rest on Jaipur-specific aggregated sources, beer is cross-checked against Jaipur pub and draught prices, and wine uses a Jaipur hotel wine-by-the-glass menu. Cocktail uses a beer-relative ratio capped by Mumbai bar menus. Accommodation is a holistic judgement for a mid-sized North Indian heritage tourist city.
